name: Jenny Dahmer
source:
"I'M GONNA KILL YOU!!!"

Jenny is a ball of pent up anger and devastation waiting to be unleashed. Her power has immense potential if tamed, but until then, she'll kill anyone who tries. That is, unless you can find her sweet spot.
